evidence.field: Description; original-file link; file history; license
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 明-seal.svg as a modern vector rendering of 明 in Shuowen seal-script style, cites source collections, and labels the file public domain; attribution is appreciated but not required. It is not an ancient artifact photograph. The page links the exact original SVG at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/%E6%98%8E-seal.svg; opening that link returned HTTP 429, so the image could not be inspected or selected.

evidence.field: 字形演變; 圖形說明
evidence.text: The 明 record groups forms under oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, small-seal, and Shuowen ancient-script labels and presents the 日+月 explanation. It identifies a bronze example as 集成00161. The page states that it is copyrighted, so it is cited as evidence rather than used as a glyph image.
evidence.title: 漢字「明」：字形演變

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Innovating Digital Archives for Archaeological Data
evidence.field: 明 explanation in 甲骨文 中與「天」相關的字
evidence.text: The 2019 exhibition account interprets a moon-and-window form as moonlight entering a room and says the window component 囧 can become graphically similar to 日. This is a source's interpretation, not a resolution of the competing early form analyses.
evidence.title: 甲骨文 中與「天」相關的字

search_audit.outcome: Opened the exact Commons description page and inspected its original-file link, source notes, style label, file history, and public-domain statement. The original SVG request returned HTTP 429.

search_audit.query: 明 甲骨文 字形 明 朙 囧 Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang 字形演變
search_audit.outcome: Opened both institutional pages. The Sinica character record provides script-category labels and the 日+月 account; the exhibition gives a competing moon-and-window account and describes later graphical similarity between 囧 and 日.

search_audit.query: Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang glyph image CC0 rights notice
search_audit.outcome: Opened the official rights notice. It covers glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the query interface under CC0 1.0; no character-specific Xiaoxuetang image URL was established in this pass.

gaps: No image was selected: the exact Commons description page establishes the modern seal-style rendering and reuse terms, but its original SVG returned HTTP 429. The Xiaoxuetang rights notice was verified, but this pass did not establish a character-specific 明 query record and exact rendered-glyph URL.

The checked institutional sources present differing explanations of 明's early forms; the Sinica character page supports 日+月, while its archaeological exhibition gives a moon-and-window account. The sources checked here do not resolve the disagreement or independently establish the relative chronology of the forms.

limitations.text: The exact Commons file page identifies a modern Shuowen seal-style vector of 明 and states public-domain terms, but the original image request returned HTTP 429. Without access to its pixels, it is not selected as an educational glyph candidate. No character-specific Xiaoxuetang image URL was established.

Institutional accounts inspected here differ in their explanation of early 明 forms. The Sinica character record presents 日+月; the archaeological exhibition presents moon plus window and says 囧 could become graphically similar to 日. Their relative chronology and the disagreement remain unresolved here.
